claim_one_line: THE WEIL REPRESENTATION'S CENTRE GIVES THE GAUGE GROUP AND ONE GENERATION'S HYPERCHARGES, AND ONLY AT THE PRIME 5 (PROVED, exact; the web seat's W-A1 recomputed on main, with a control on rival primes; conditional on the counted postulate D): the Weil representation of SL(2, F5) on C^5 has commutant spanned by I and the parity P = rho(-I), whose eigenspaces are 3 + 2; its traceless element 6Y = (I - 5P)/2 is -2 on the 3 and 3 on the 2; the determinant-one unitaries preserving the split are (SU(3) x SU(2) x U(1))/Z6; and the even exterior powers carry exactly one generation with the record's hypercharges (Q 1, u -4, e 6, d 2, L -3, a singlet; anomaly sums zero), Lambda^1's doublet the Higgs's 3. At the primes 3, 7, 11, 13 the same split is 2 + 1, 4 + 3, 6 + 5, 7 + 6: only 5, the prime of the act's discriminant, gives the Standard Model's group. Not delivered: three families, continuous colour from the finite group, the Higgs alone. 0 of 19.
